Only one root folder needs to be authorized. The app looks for Singers and Plugins inside it and creates them when missing, then points voicebanks / plugins / phonemizers to that folder.\n\nOpenUtau Mobile keeps singers in its private app directory, which other apps cannot read, so its \"Additional Singer Search Paths\" must be pointed to the Singers subfolder of this root.

Uses an accelerator when GitHub is unreachable; switches routes on failure; adapts connections per site

Measured: on this device direct connections to github.com time out, so an accelerator route is required to download voicebanks/plugins hosted on GitHub. Japanese sites and authors\' own sites (e.g. kasaneteto.jp) work fine directly, and going through the accelerator is actually slower.
Version, third-party licenses and known risks
Risk: OpenUtau Mobile is unstable and may cause project data loss; save frequently. Direct links and network states in the catalogue expire over time; rely on actual probes.

A voicebank / plugin / phonemizer manager for OpenUtau Mobile. It is separate from OpenUtau Mobile itself, does not modify its source, and interacts only through the file system. Colors and control metrics are taken from stakira/OpenUtau (MIT); icons come from Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons (MIT). All rights belong to the original authors.

UtauLibrary Mobile only installs and manages resources for OpenUtau Mobile.

On first use, authorize a single root folder. The app creates Singers and Plugins inside it and points voicebanks / plugins / phonemizers to that folder.

We suggest creating a folder in shared storage first (for example /storage/emulated/0/OpenUtau), adding its Singers subfolder to OpenUtau Mobile's "Additional Singer Search Paths", then returning here to authorize that folder.
Note: OpenUtau Mobile is currently quite unstable and has memory and crash issues; save your project frequently.

Please confirm the following before downloading: The voices, plugins and phonemizers listed here come from public distribution by their respective authors. This app only collects and downloads; it does not host or redistribute files. Please read and follow each author\'s terms of use, and credit the original author when using. Commercial use requires the author\'s permission. Some sources require a netdisk account, a proxy, or manual extraction. Please comply with local laws and platform rules. The app is not responsible for any loss caused by broken links, file corruption or misuse.

This app is a companion resource manager for OpenUtau Mobile and cannot synthesize on its own. OpenUtau Mobile is not installed on this device. Download it from GitHub?
UtauLibrary Mobile manages resources for OpenUtau Mobile. Both apps must point to the same storage folder so downloaded resources can be loaded by OpenUtau Mobile.
Step 1 · Enable the extra singer folder in OpenUtau Mobile
Open OpenUtau Mobile → Settings → Files & Storage and enable:
Install singers into the extra singer folder
This allows OpenUtau Mobile to load singers from outside its private app directory.
Step 2 · Authorize that folder in UtauLibrary Mobile
Open UtauLibrary Mobile → Settings → Folders, tap Authorize, and pick a folder in shared storage (e.g. OpenUtau). Singers and Plugins subfolders will be created automatically.
Tip: if OpenUtau Mobile does not pick up newly installed singers, add the Singers subfolder to Additional Singer Search Paths manually.
These steps can be revisited anytime in Settings → Folders.

Fixes 1. Download integrity: byte count and archive entry count are verified strictly. 2. Write verification: each file and the whole folder are checked after copying. 3. Installed detection now matches the installer probing depth. 4. Post-install read-back: unreadable targets are treated as failures and rolled back. 5. Installed list refreshes immediately after deletion. 6. Size statistics no longer stop at 600 files. 7. Failures show the real reason (e.g. HTTP 403) and are logged to Download. 8. Falls back to a single connection when the server ignores Range.
New 1. Clean leftovers action on the Installed page. 2. Keep cached file when a download fails (troubleshooting). 3. Teto combined editions now show year and size in the name.
